people.name: Zacchaeus
people.line: Tax collector who hosted Jesus in Jericho

translations.web: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
translations.bsb: And there was a man named Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, who was very wealthy.
translations.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
translations.asv: And behold, a man called by name Zacchaeus; and he was a chief publican, and he was rich.
